name: Store last URL for iframe apps
description:
Here is a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. The task involved updating the `AppWindow.vue` component in a window manager UI.
2. The goal was to capture the iframe's page title after it finishes loading.
3. A `readIframeUrl` method was added to read both `location.href` and `document.title` from the iframe's `contentWindow`.
4. The `persistUrl` method was updated to store the page title alongside the `lastUrl` in the app params via the store.
5. Cross-origin iframes are handled gracefully by wrapping the access in a `try/catch` block.

messages.content:
We must keep tracking of the urls navigated in AppWindow and store in the params so we can recover the latest url when retoring the desktop.
Store last naviagted url in the app params using $ui to update app params. And load lastUrl if present
listen to iframe onload event and read the url from contentWindow.location.href
Read the "title" of the loaded page and if it's valid store with the url as "title" in the params
